chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah and Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar and 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, all of them, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee', from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Order our Shia to go to the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). Verily, going to it increases sustenance, prolongs life, and repels the forces of evil. And going to it is obligatory upon every believer who acknowledges for al-Husayn the Imamate from Allah.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits and ruling of visiting the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.) in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Compiled by Ibn Qulawayh in *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) elevates Ziyarat al-Husayn from a recommended act to a mandatory duty (fard) for those affirming his divine Imamate. It underscores the tangible spiritual and physical rewards of this pilgrimage, linking devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt with increased sustenance (rizq), longevity, and the removal of calamities, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the intercessory and barakah-filled nature of the Imams' graves.
